resources.string: Wi-Fi is ready. Select files to copy now. The connection closes automatically after a minute or when you leave Halo.
Turn on Wi-Fi to copy files from the glasses, then try again. Internet access is not needed.
Choose the glasses already paired in Android. Android will ask you to approve Halo’s access.
Keep the glasses nearby and select them as soon as they appear. Approve Android’s connection prompt. If the connection stalls, cancel and try again. Files stay on this phone.
